Title: Meta Webhook Signature Bypass & Graph API Amplification
Description: assertWebhookSignature returns early if signatureHeader is missing or if secrets array is empty.
Harm & Hack Vector: Attackers or bots can send forged webhook payloads to /webhooks/meta with no signature. The server calls Meta Graph API for each leadgen_id using the organization's Page token, leading to Meta API rate-limit exhaustion, account bans, server socket starvation, and CRM data poisoning.
Remediation: Require signature header presence; reject request if header is missing or HMAC verification fails.

Title: Authentication Bypass via Incomplete Signup Drafts
Description: POST /auth/resume-signup and POST /auth/signup/step1/preview issue active JWT access and refresh tokens without verifying passwords, OTP, or email.
Harm & Hack Vector: An attacker who knows or enumerates the email or ID of any user in onboarding (onboardingStep != 'completed') can hijack their account and draft organization without credentials.
Remediation: Do not issue authentication JWTs without credentials; require password entry or a verified one-time email login link.

Title: Public Lead Capture Form Bot Flood
Description: POST /org/leads accepts public inquiries anonymously with no CAPTCHA, honeypot field, or IP rate limiting.
Harm & Hack Vector: Automated bots can spam thousands of fake submissions, triggering outgoing SMTP email notifications to agents, burning email domain reputation, exhausting database storage, and maxing out CRM plan quotas.
Remediation: Add Cloudflare Turnstile / reCAPTCHA, honeypot fields, and IP rate limiting with @nestjs/throttler.

Title: AI Custom Provider SSRF & Credential Exfiltration
Description: AiSettingsService permits configuring arbitrary HTTP/HTTPS URLs in ai_generate_api_url without validating loopback or private network destinations.
Harm & Hack Vector: If compromised or manipulated, the backend makes HTTP POST requests containing internal headers and the AI API key to internal cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) or internal services (localhost:3000), leaking tokens.
Remediation: Enforce HTTPS-only and block RFC-1918 private IP ranges and link-local cloud metadata addresses.

Title: Meta OAuth State Parameter Tampering / CSRF
Description: getConnectUrl generates state as unauthenticated base64url-encoded JSON with no signature or nonce; handleOAuthCallback trusts the parsed orgId.
Harm & Hack Vector: Attackers can forge state payloads to link their Facebook/Instagram pages to a victim's organization or trick an admin via CSRF into connecting external accounts.
Remediation: Sign state with HMAC-SHA256 using an application secret or store a single-use random state in Redis/DB.

Title: S3/R2 Arbitrary Object Deletion IDOR
Description: registerMedia accepts user-supplied storedKey; deleteMedia passes storedKey directly to S3 DeleteObjectCommand without checking org ownership prefix.
Harm & Hack Vector: An authenticated user from one tenant can register an asset pointing to another tenant's files or system assets, then delete it, causing cross-tenant data destruction.
Remediation: Derive storedKey strictly server-side and ensure all delete operations verify that key starts with ^orgs/${orgId}/.

Title: Permissive CORS Configuration with Allowed Credentials
Description: main.ts sets app.enableCors({ origin: true, credentials: true }), reflecting the request origin dynamically.
Harm & Hack Vector: Malicious websites can initiate authenticated cross-origin requests using a victim's browser session if credentials/cookies are active.
Remediation: Replace origin: true with an explicit whitelist of trusted application domains.

Title: Unthrottled 6-Digit Email Verification Code Brute Force
Description: The 6-digit numeric verification OTP is valid for 1 hour with no maximum attempt counter and no rate limiting.
Harm & Hack Vector: With 1,000,000 possibilities and no attempt threshold, an attacker or script can brute-force the OTP within the 60-minute window to verify arbitrary emails.
Remediation: Invalidate the token after 5 failed attempts, reduce expiration to 10 minutes, and add rate limiting.

Title: Unauthenticated Draft Organization Deletion
Description: POST /auth/signup/step1/restart takes existingUserId with no authentication and deletes the user and entire draft organization.
Harm & Hack Vector: An attacker can iterate over user IDs and wipe in-progress tenant signups and draft configurations.
Remediation: Require session authentication or a signed email verification token before deleting draft data.

Title: Google Sheets Webhook Secret Timing Attack
Description: handleWebhook compares incoming tokens using standard === string equality instead of constant-time comparison.
Harm & Hack Vector: Attackers can measure microsecond response time differences to sequentially deduce the webhook secret key character-by-character.
Remediation: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual on byte buffers to compare secrets.

Title: Third-Party API Secrets & Tokens Stored in Plaintext
Description: Meta access tokens, WhatsApp tokens, Gemini/Anthropic keys, and webhook secrets are stored as plaintext in PostgreSQL.
Harm & Hack Vector: A database compromise or SQL dump immediately exposes all external third-party access tokens and platform credentials.
Remediation: Encrypt access tokens and app secrets at rest using AES-256-GCM.

Title: CRM Lead Scope Leak: Unassigned Leads Exposed to All Sales Agents
Description: actorLeadOrClauses injects { assignedToId: null } into orClauses for every non-admin user query.
Harm & Hack Vector: Standard sales agents can view all unassigned leads across the entire company, including projects and territories they are not part of.
Remediation: Restrict { assignedToId: null } strictly to projects where the user is an assigned sales agent.

Title: Runtime Crash in Public Lead Capture (trackingEvent.create)
Description: LeadsService.createFromPublic invokes this.prisma.trackingEvent.create(...) without verifying trackingEvent exists or is initialized.
Harm & Hack Vector: Throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'create') on public lead submissions and causes 5 unit test failures.
Remediation: Add optional chaining (this.prisma.trackingEvent?.create(...)) and update test mock fixtures.

Title: Template Lookup Method Mismatch in Leads Service
Description: LeadsService calls this.prisma.template.findFirst(...), while test mocks only define findUnique.
Harm & Hack Vector: Causes TypeError: this.prisma.template.findFirst is not a function during test suite execution.
Remediation: Align method signature in service and mock definitions.

Title: Project Wizard Vitest Timeout
Description: project-wizard.test.tsx times out after 5,000ms on multi-step required field validation.
Harm & Hack Vector: Vitest reports test failure due to slow DOM rendering across multi-step validation checks.
Remediation: Optimize state renders or increase testTimeout for long-running wizard tests.
